oneLine: Sunil Singhania-led Abakkus Asset Manager files IPO papers with SEBI.

sources.title: Sunil Singhania-led Abakkus Asset Manager files IPO papers with SEBI

synopsis: Sunil Singhania-led Abakkus Asset Manager Ltd. has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI to raise funds through an initial public offering. The proposed IPO consists of an offer for sale of 15 million shares with a face value of ₹2 per share, featuring a 35 percent reservation for retail investors and an employee reservation. Axis Capital, ICICI Securities, IIFL Capital, and JM Financial are acting as the book-running lead managers for the issue. Founded in 2018, the Mumbai-based asset management platform operates across alternatives, portfolio management, advisory, private equity, and mutual funds, with non-mutual fund QAAUM standing at ₹41,409 crore as of FY26.
